description: This Java test class, OpenmrsObjectSaveHandlerTest, contains unit tests for the OpenmrsObjectSaveHandler class, specifically testing how it handles setting properties to null or trimming strings based on annotations such as @AllowEmptyStrings and @AllowLeadingOrTrailingWhitespace in the context of OpenMRS domain objects.

classes.name: OpenmrsObjectSaveHandlerTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for testing the behavior of OpenmrsObjectSaveHandler on various OpenMRS objects, focusing on handling string properties with specific annotations.

classes.name: SomeClass
classes.description: An inner class used within the test class, extending BaseOpenmrsObject, with properties 'name' and 'description' annotated with @AllowEmptyStrings and @AllowLeadingOrTrailingWhitespace' respectively, used to verify handling of string properties.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetEmptyStringPropertiesToNull
methods.description: Test that empty strings assigned to properties are set to null by the handler.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetEmptyStringPropertiesToNullForAllowEmptyStringsAnnotation
methods.description: Test that properties annotated with @AllowEmptyStrings retain their empty string value.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotTrimEmptyStringsForAllowLeadingOrTrailingWhitespaceAnnotation
methods.description: Test that properties annotated with @AllowLeadingOrTrailingWhitespace are not trimmed.

methods.name: handle_shouldTrimStringsWithoutAllowLeadingOrTrailingWhitespaceAnnotation
methods.description: Test that string properties are trimmed if no specific annotation is present.

methods.name: handle_shouldTrimEmptyStringsForAllowEmptyStringsAnnotation
methods.description: Test that string properties with @AllowEmptyStrings are trimmed if they contain whitespace.
